name: Container & Kubernetes Forensics
description: Ability to perform forensic investigation of containerised environments including Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration platforms. Covers container image analysis, runtime artifact collection, pod and node forensics, container escape detection, and dealing with the ephemeral nature of container workloads.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands container architectures and the unique forensic challenges they present
evidence: Can describe Docker and Kubernetes architecture at a level relevant to forensics
Understands why container ephemerality complicates evidence collection
Can explain the difference between container image layers and runtime state

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Collects and examines container artifacts under supervision
evidence: Exported and analysed Docker container filesystem layers under guidance
Collected Kubernetes audit logs and pod event histories
Examined container image manifests and layer diffs for suspicious modifications
Documented container evidence collection with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently investigates container security incidents and preserves ephemeral container evidence
evidence: Independently investigated container-based incidents in 3+ engagements
Preserved running container state (filesystem, process list, network connections) before termination
Analysed container images to identify supply chain compromise or backdoored images
Produced container forensic reports detailing evidence collection methodology

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Investigates complex Kubernetes cluster compromises; detects container escapes; develops container forensic tooling
evidence: Investigated Kubernetes cluster-level compromises involving RBAC abuse and lateral movement
Detected container escape attempts and node-level compromise from container artifacts
Developed automated container evidence collection scripts for incident response
Mentors analysts on container forensics methodology and Kubernetes security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines container forensics methodology; researches new container attack artifacts; advises on forensic-ready container architectures
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's container and Kubernetes forensics methodology
Published research on container forensic artifacts or investigation techniques
Advises organisations on container logging and runtime monitoring for forensic readiness
Trains teams on container forensics and Kubernetes incident investigation

assessment_methods.description: Investigate a simulated Kubernetes cluster compromise: collect container and cluster artifacts, determine attack vector, and document findings
Given a scenario where suspicious containers have already been terminated, determine what evidence is available and reconstruct the incident
